hints.title: Window Delimitation
hints.text: Any shortest beautiful substring must begin and end with '1' and contain exactly k ones.

hints.title: Sliding Window On Ones
hints.text: Collect all indices where s[i] == '1'. Every block of k consecutive ones forms a candidate substring s[ones[i] : ones[i + k - 1] + 1].

hints.title: Length and Lexicographical Ranking
hints.text: Among all candidate substrings of minimum length, pick the one that is lexicographically smallest.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Collecting 1-indices followed by sliding window comparison.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all O(n^2) substrings with slicing takes O(n^3).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use 1-indices sliding window with length and lexicographical tie-breaking.
